title: Kumamoto shelter occupancy aggregate layer
disclosure: Official reports provide prefecture-wide shelter and occupant totals, not a trustworthy time series for each shelter. This layer preserves only those aggregates. It must not assign occupants to individual shelters, infer municipal opening times, or portray a modeled distribution as observed.

observed_aggregate_points.source_note: Maximum shelter-count observation in the reconstruction.
Daytime aggregate after the first-night peak count.
Maximum recorded occupant count; it is not contemporaneous with the 506-shelter maximum.
Aggregate at the Cabinet Office report-4 cutoff.

derived_display.allowed_visual: A clearly labeled prefecture-wide occupancy pulse or counter.
derived_display.forbidden_visual: People, capacity, opening time, or occupancy assigned to a specific shelter or municipality.

source.attribution: Cabinet Office and Kumamoto Prefecture official aggregates; modeled display by AURAWORLD
